name: Cila
source: Cila, a native of the Empire and one of the Daughters of Velta, was created in an artificial womb. Naturally strong, intelligent, and with a gift for dealing with androids, she used to be in the Special Forces. Now a cybersecurity expert at Hoplon Security, recent events in her life have left her alone and resentful, which has affected her character and effectiveness in her work.
